content:
Saturday, November 7, is a stacked day for fight fans, with a UFC main event in Las Vegas and two major boxing cards in England — followed on Sunday by a women's world title fight in Texas.

In Las Vegas, UFC Fight Night takes over the Meta APEX with a heavyweight main event between Waldo Cortes-Acosta and Johnny Walker, streaming on Paramount+. The bout was elevated to the main event after the originally scheduled Gabriel Bonfim vs. Sean Brady headliner was canceled when Brady was removed with a knee infection. Cortes-Acosta, ranked No. 6 at heavyweight, gets his first UFC main event against No. 12-ranked Walker, who recently made his heavyweight debut with a first-round knockout of Mick Parkin.

The co-main event keeps the spotlight on the women's strawweight division, where No. 2-ranked Tatiana Suarez meets No. 3-ranked Virna Jandiroba. Both have competed for the world championship, and the winner positions herself for another title shot.

Across the Atlantic, Manchester's AO Arena hosts Joshua Buatsi vs. Willy Hutchinson II for the WBC light heavyweight world championship on DAZN. In London, Zuffa Boxing returns to the Copper Box Arena with former world champion Chris Billam-Smith facing Olympian Chev Clarke (12-2, 9 KOs) in a cruiserweight main event a decade in the making, a rematch of their amateur rivalry with world title implications.

On Sunday, November 8, women's boxing takes center stage in Texas. Alycia Baumgardner moves up to 135 pounds to challenge undefeated IBF lightweight champion Elif Nur Turhan (14-0, 8 KOs) at the College Park Center in Arlington, airing on ESPN. Baumgardner is attempting to become a two-division world champion.

Looking ahead, the UFC also handed out its October honors on November 3. Mike Malott earned Breakout Performance honors after knocking out Joaquin Buckley at UFC Edmonton, extending his winning streak to five and cracking the welterweight top ten. Abus Magomedov claimed Submission of the Month for his guillotine choke of Cam Rowston at UFC 333, Julian Erosa earned Knockout of the Month for his first-round finish of JeongYeong Lee, and Petr Yan's unanimous-decision trilogy win over Merab Dvalishvili at UFC 333 was named Fight of the Month.

And in a major announcement Wednesday, Dana White confirmed that former WBC heavyweight champion Deontay Wilder will face undefeated cruiserweight king Jai Opetaia (31-0) as the co-main event of the Tyson Fury vs. Anthony Joshua card on Friday, December 11, at Principality Stadium in Cardiff, Wales, live on Netflix. Opetaia moves up to heavyweight for the bout.

Sources: UFC.com; Fight Week; Yardbarker; Bloody Elbow.

excerpt: Waldo Cortes-Acosta meets Johnny Walker in the UFC Fight Night main event Saturday in Las Vegas, Buatsi-Hutchinson II and Billam-Smith-Clarke headline boxing cards in England, and Alycia Baumgardner challenges Elif Nur Turhan for the IBF lightweight title Sunday in Arlington, Texas.
title: Fight Weekend Preview: Cortes-Acosta vs. Walker Headlines UFC in Las Vegas, Buatsi-Hutchinson II and Billam-Smith-Clarke in England, Baumgardner Chases Second Title in Texas
